description: Land Acquisition - Thembilipitiya, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple land lots (Lots 1-15) totaling approximately 5.5970 Hectares in the Kegalle District. The content focuses exclusively on land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and acquisition procedures for a public purpose, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
